name: codex-conversation-tree
description: Continue and fork Codex conversations in an interactive tree view.

interface.longDescription: Browse local Codex chats as a tree of Turns, continue an existing chat, and fork from a completed Turn. Forks stay visible under their source Turn. Requires Codex desktop, Node.js, and the Codex CLI on PATH. This beta does not merge chats or provide session-to-session messaging.
